name: Two-part foldable hinge: motion + screen and cable keepouts

requirements.statement: Reference screen packages have noninterfering swept/closed space.

requirements.statement: Reserve a service-loop envelope external to the hinge, without falsely claiming routed cable.

requirements.statement: Folded CAD envelope meets declared thickness limit.

requirements.statement: Two real ring references in grooved pin should geometrically block axial escape.

verification.procedure: Install sourced calibrated circlips and measure pin axial travel, groove seating, force and wear.

requirements.statement: A named hypothetical round wire spans both fold endpoints with bounded path length and curvature.

verification.procedure: Choose actual FFC/cable datasheet, anchor mechanical connectors, then fold repeatedly under camera.

requirements.statement: The total cable free loop must not be confused with printed-only closed shell thickness.

verification.procedure: Measure folded assembly with physical cable, retainer and display packages including routing bulges.
